[[Jacado the Putrid]] is located at the end of a room filled with [[Zombie Brute]]s.

*[[Jacado's Staff]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
*Jacado and his accompanying Zombie Brutes guard an [[Area Map]].
*When you enter the room the Zombie Brutes are not hostile, but going near him will make them attack you.

==Trivia==
*He is one of the few [[NPC]]s that possess more than one [[elite skill]].
